overview: uMucyo BookingServices is a single-provider service booking app for Mucyo Answer in Nyagatare, Rwanda. Customers browse and book from a diverse range of local services including cleaning, hair salon, plumbing, tailoring, car wash, catering, and more — without needing an account.
features: Book appointments without creating an account
About Us page with business mission
Contact Us page with Mucyo Answer details
Provider dashboard to manage services and availability
